visual.description: Warm dusty rose background that fills the entire page.
Dark brownish-gray used for the studio name, tagline, and descriptive text.
Pure black used for the logo mark and icon elements within the logo.
White fill used as the background of the primary Enter button.
Near-black text color used on the Enter button label and arrow icon.
Dark muted tone used for the small 'ENTER WITHOUT AUDIO' underlined link at the bottom.
Black border outlining the logo's oval frame shape.
